title: Computer-aided development of novel thiazolidinone-thiazole derivatives: multidimensional structure-activity relationships revealed by quantum chemical analysis, molecular docking and biological investigation.
authors: Iqbal, Tayyiaba; Khan, Shoaib; Khan, Asrar; Sajjad, Hassnain; Almalki, Masi A; Abid, Souhir; Abid, Majdi; Ali, Syed Kashif; Bakridin, Zaripov; Baltabay, Eshmuratov; Gomha, Sobhi M; Zaki, Magdi E A
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过分子对接和DFT计算辅助设计噻唑烷酮-噻唑衍生物作为α-淀粉酶/α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂，涉及蛋白质-配体对接但核心是药物化学而非蛋白质结构计算建模，方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: Diabetes mellitus is a major global health challenge, highlighting the need for new inhibitors of the carbohydrate-hydrolyzing enzymes alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase. In this study, a series of thiazole-based thiazolidinone derivatives (1-10) was designed, synthesized, and structurally characterized using spectroscopic techniques. Among the synthesized compounds, 8 showed the strongest inhibitory activity against alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase, with IC(50) values of 5.50 +/- 0.40 and 5.90 +/- 0.10 microM, respectively, and compared with 10.80 +/- 0.50 and 11.10 +/- 0.30 microM for acarbose. Molecular docking suggested that compound 8 can adopt a favorable binding orientation within the active sites of both enzymes through hydrogen-bonding and hydrophobic contacts. Enzyme kinetic studies further characterized its mode of inhibition. DFT calculations were performed to examine the electronic properties, frontier molecular orbitals, and molecular electrostatic potential of selected derivatives. ADMET analysis was also conducted to provide preliminary insight into their predicted pharmacokinetic and toxicity-related properties. Overall, the experimental and computational findings identify compound 8 as a promising lead structure for further investigation as an alpha-amylase and alpha-glucosidase inhibitor.
abstract_zh: 糖尿病是全球性的重大健康挑战，凸显了对碳水化合物水解酶α-淀粉酶和α-葡萄糖苷酶新型抑制剂的需求。本研究设计、合成了一系列基于噻唑的噻唑烷酮衍生物（1-10），并利用光谱技术对其结构进行了表征。在合成的化合物中，化合物8对α-淀粉酶和α-葡萄糖苷酶表现出最强的抑制活性，其IC(50)值分别为5.50 ± 0.40和5.90 ± 0.10微摩尔，而阿卡波糖的对应值为10.80 ± 0.50和11.10 ± 0.30微摩尔。分子对接表明，化合物8可通过氢键和疏水接触在两种酶的活性位点内采用有利的结合取向。酶动力学研究进一步表征了其抑制模式。进行了DFT计算以考察所选衍生物的电子性质、前沿分子轨道和分子静电势。还进行了ADMET分析，以初步了解其预测的药代动力学和毒性相关性质。总体而言，实验和计算研究结果将化合物8确定为一种有前景的先导结构，值得进一步研究其作为α-淀粉酶和α-葡萄糖苷酶抑制剂的潜力。
